_comment: THE ROUTED COURSE'S PINS (decided 2026-11-11/12: the front page's second course, ASAP7 placed and routed). What a routed result must have been made under to be comparable with one made now: the image (OpenROAD-flow-scripts, used by digest, x86-64 only), the flow `min_v1` and its variables, the threads, CPU affinity and memory cap of a job, the sha256 of the scripts that render each job's config.mk and SDC, and the rules that turn a run into a score (area, time, validity). Every leaderboard/asap7pnr/<task>.json copies them in its `course` block; a file whose block differs is stale (leaderboard.py `asap7pnr_identity`, `asap7pnr_table_mismatch`), and its designs show no routed number. Changing a pin means routing every design again.

The image's ASAP7 platform: its five liberty files are byte-identical to the BSD 3-Clause files score/ppa_pins_asap7.json pins (OpenROAD-flow-scripts a1a6c3ff); the platform's other files are those of the image's OpenROAD-flow-scripts (score/PPA.md, "ASAP7 placed and routed"). None of them is in this repository.

course.validity_rule: ORFS exit 0, detailed-route DRC 0, every LEC log of the flow 'Circuits are IDENTICAL', and the reference-against-routed check IDENTICAL (decided 2026-11-13): after the flow, kepler-formal in the pinned image with the flow's own configuration of the run, its reference the bound netlist file (sha256 = the entry's netlist_sha256), its other side the run's routed 6_final_lec.v, its log printing 'Circuits are IDENTICAL' and neither 'Found difference' nor 'Circuits are DIFFERENT' (score/pnr/lec.py) (DRV counts recorded, not part of validity)
